## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` passes locally / `pytest` passe en local
- [ ] `ruff check src tests examples` passes / `ruff check src tests examples` passe
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change, if applicable / Tests ajoutés/mis à jour si pertinent
- [ ] `README.md` **and** `README.fr.md` updated, if user-facing behavior changed / `README.md` **et** `README.fr.md` mis à jour, si le comportement visible a changé
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` / `CHANGELOG.md` mis à jour sous `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] I've read `CONTRIBUTING.md` / J'ai lu `CONTRIBUTING.md`
